note: Curated, balanced accounts. Refreshed by the daily 7am routine via the X connector.

posts.name: Cook Political Report
posts.text: The Cook Political Report has moved 19 more House races, all in Democrats' direction. Six districts are moving from the Toss Up column to Lean Democrat. Two more open seats are moving from Lean Republican to Toss Up.

posts.name: Cook Political Report
posts.text: The Cook Political Report has moved the Ohio Governor's race from Toss Up to Lean Democrat.

posts.name: Dave Wasserman
posts.text: Think back to 2006, last midterm w/ an unpopular war/GOP president. Where were the biggest House upsets? Places like IN, IA, KS, MN (Tim Walz!), NH, OH, WI, Upstate NY. That's why I think the Midwest & places w/ lots of secular white voters are especially ripe for surprises.

posts.name: Nate Silver
posts.text: I'm not sure what it would take to de-entrench the presumption that polls systematically underrate conservative parties or candidates. It's not true historically, but it's a cheapie take that will never really get you criticized.

posts.name: Nate Silver
posts.text: The gap between FLIPR and prediction markets is closing, but I thought some of you would appreciate a column that goes into detail about the disagreements. It comes down to state-by-state differences of opinion, rather than anything overly "macro".

posts.name: G Elliott Morris
posts.text: We don't know if the early vote will be predictive bc all Reps could just be waiting to vote until Elec Day. What this means in practice is that to win, the GOP will have to have the most successful EDay mobilization operation in modern history.

posts.name: Kyle Kondik
posts.text: NYT/Philadelphia Inquirer/Siena House polling of PA this morning. The tie in PA-10 is good for Rs -- the others are good for Ds.

posts.name: Decision Desk HQ
posts.text: Our polling average for Montana's 1st congressional district is live! Sam Forstag (D) 46.6%, Aaron Flint (R) 44.8%. In the DDHQ Forecast, Flint is favored with a 62% win probability.

posts.name: Simon Rosenberg
posts.text: Monday morning early vote update via TargetEarly. We continue to see very strong and encouraging early vote turnout from young, Black, and Hispanic voters compared to this day in 2022. Black voters up 9%, 18-29 up 20%, Hispanic up 38%.

posts.text: Vivek Ramaswamy and his hair were on Fox & Friends this morning defending his vile attack ad

posts.name: Matthew Yglesias
posts.text: With the billionaire realignment under way, Democrats edge with small dollar donors is more important than ever and that means party leaders need to be much better stewards of their donors' good faith and good intentions.

posts.name: Byron York
posts.text: Over the weekend Trump held a rally in Port Huron, Michigan, in a congressional district he won by 32 points in 2024. He asked supporters to vote like he was on the ballot, which made a lot of sense, given that a 32-point victory in the district helped Trump win statewide.

posts.name: Byron York
posts.text: Why does Trump tell midterm crowds to "Pretend I'm on the ballot"? You have to know the numbers behind the phrase "low-propensity voters."

posts.name: Byron York
posts.text: Schiff has already had two Trump impeachments. What about his fellow Democrats? There are already 60-plus House Democrats who were first elected in 2022/2024. If there's a blue wave, there will be more. What about their Trump impeachment?

posts.name: Byron York
posts.text: Interviews with El-Sayed are both useless and extremely revealing. By asking simple, straightforward questions, @bretbaier helped viewers see and understand how El-Sayed works.
